tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe added two measurements with widely separated sink gradients, addressing the pilot's main identifiability gap. Fit the three parameters of the documented sink-inhibited siphon plus signed square-root branch against all seven paid rows; no further measurement is justified before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Observed maximum s_grad is 2.35, below the documented >2.36 trigger; the current rows already span low and high gradient values.
All observations share H and the response is consistent with the simpler static siphon form; no trajectory data are needed for the selected fit.
The available rows do not vary initial memory/state or horizon, and the static siphon with an open branch is directly testable on the existing gradient and input span.
These are more complex alternatives; the observed monotone concavity and strong sink response are captured by the simpler documented siphon law.
